name: @199bio/exa-mcp-server

tools.name: web_search
tools.description: Searches the web in real-time. Returns: page content, titles, URLs. Use when: need current information beyond training data.

numResults.description: Number of results to return (1-20, default: 5)

liveCrawl.description: Content fetching: 'always' = fresh content, 'auto' = balance speed/freshness, 'fallback' = cache first, 'never' = cache only (default: auto)

tools.name: academic_search
tools.description: Searches academic papers and research. Returns: paper abstracts, citations, authors. Use when: need peer-reviewed sources.

query.description: Academic search query (e.g., 'quantum computing algorithms', 'CRISPR gene editing')

numResults.description: Number of papers to return (1-20, default: 5)

tools.name: company_search
tools.description: Searches company information and news. Returns: business data, financials, recent news. Use when: researching businesses or organizations.

numResults.description: Number of results to return (1-20, default: 5)

tools.name: url_content
tools.description: Extracts full content from specific URLs. Returns: complete page text, metadata. Use when: have exact URL to analyze.

liveCrawl.description: Content fetching: 'always' = fresh content, 'auto' = balance speed/freshness, 'fallback' = cache first, 'never' = cache only (default: auto)

tools.name: competitor_search
tools.description: Finds business competitors. Returns: similar companies, market analysis. Use when: asked 'who competes with X' or competitive analysis.

numResults.description: Number of competitors to find (1-20, default: 5)

tools.name: linkedin_search
tools.description: Searches LinkedIn profiles and companies. Returns: professional profiles, company pages. Use when: researching people or professional networks.

query.description: Search query (e.g., 'John Doe software engineer', 'Apple Inc')

searchType.description: Filter: 'profiles' for people, 'companies' for orgs, 'all' for both (default: all)

numResults.description: Number of results to return (1-20, default: 5)

tools.name: wikipedia_search
tools.description: Searches Wikipedia encyclopedia. Returns: article summaries, factual content. Use when: need encyclopedic or reference information.

query.description: Search query (e.g., 'quantum mechanics', 'World War II', 'Python programming')

numResults.description: Number of articles to return (1-20, default: 5)

tools.name: github_search
tools.description: Searches GitHub repositories and code. Returns: repos, code snippets, READMEs. Use when: looking for code examples or open source projects.

query.description: Search query (e.g., 'machine learning Python', 'react hooks examples')

numResults.description: Number of results to return (1-20, default: 5)
